label: Semeru: SIGMETs move the ash SE while VONAs say N/NE, 23-27 Sep 2026 (reconstructed)
notes: Reconstructed from archives, not recorded live. VA SIGMETs from the hourly aviationweather.gov date= snapshots the research census saved (real AWC JSON, research/data/census). Darwin VAA bulletins (FVAU01-10 ADRM) from the IEM NOAAPort archive, the public-domain relay whose files NWS serves on tgftp: each is stored under the tgftp slot of its heading at the later of its DTG and its arrival, with every slot's last bulletin before the window, and copies relayed twice are merged. Nothing comes from BoM's FTP server. Darwin bulletins that NOAAPort re-sent between 10:00Z on 23 Sep 2026 and 15:00Z on 23 Sep 2026 after newer ones on the same slots (36) are left out, because a slot holds Darwin's newest advisory on its heading. The streamed days hold no bulletin for FVAU09, FVAU10 before the window, so each starts with an empty 204 record, which the poller reads as unavailable. MAGMA VONA list pages as the research census fetched them on 9 Oct 2026; the poller reads only notices issued before the replay clock, from their list cards. TAFs from aviationweather.gov date= history (real AWC JSON), hourly, under the station lists the replay's pollers request (found by probing the case). METARs from aviationweather.gov date= history (real AWC JSON), hourly, under the station lists the replay's pollers request (found by probing the case). Pressure-level winds from the Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API (CC BY 4.0, Weather data by Open-Meteo.com), hourly, under the live winds URLs: each response is the archive's answer for the same fields from one hour before to 23 hours after its time (start_hour/end_hour in place of past_hours/forecast_hours). These are short-range model runs stitched together, not the forecast that was current then. Not in this case, and shown as such: Tokyo VAAC, ADS-B, Satellite frames, Himawari HSD. VONA list pages rebuilt from PVMBG's notices: each notice's summary paragraph as PVMBG wrote it, with MAGMA's page chrome, staff names, tokens and beacons removed; they are not MAGMA's pages.
